scope: Implementation and software validation complete; local real-data execution required

tasks.acceptance: Frozen inputs and references agree; pinned BoxMOT and TrackEval source verified; original-video grouping explicit
Official CLEAR frame counts agree; GT coverage overlap, identity events and censored followups recorded; missing logs remain unknown

tasks.probe: Full P/N/C and identity-competition diagnostics collected in this run

tasks.acceptance: Formal MOT matches historical BG; P/C diagnostic replay remains read-only; pure N counterfactual explicitly unavailable with dual_low
Identity-preserving human review with reviewer and reason; uncertain is allowed; no propagation beyond reviewed scope

entry_conditions: Repeatable mechanism evidence with online-available signals
Correct recoveries distinguishable from harmful recoveries
Support beyond the main design videos
One primary change selected before closed-loop evaluation

interpretation.GT_use: Separate offline labeling and evaluation only
interpretation.P_N_C: Conditional effects; not three additive gains or full alternate trackers
interpretation.data_role: Previously used official test sequences are development data
interpretation.timing: Cached-feature/warp replay and observer timing are not end-to-end deployment FPS
